summary: Canvas and WebGL got several robustness and limits improvements: failures from MapBufferRange and readbacks are handled more safely, uploads now use shared PBOs for efficiency, vertex group behavior was relaxed for overlapping data, and WebGL buffer-size limits were aligned with WebGPU. macOS got hooks to control using Metal ANGLE for WebGL and PVRTC compressed texture support was disabled platform-wide to avoid issues; overall this reduces crashes and improves stability for GPU-accelerated canvas content.
